title: Flow Cytometry Monocyte Adhesion Assay for Endothelial Activation Quantification
author: Vinnyfred Vincent
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ban5idg6

steps.title: Coat plate with gelatin
steps.instruction: Add 1 ml of 0.2 % gelatin in PBS to each well of a 6‑well plate; incubate in a CO₂ incubator at 37 °C for 1 hour.

steps.title: Remove gelatin and wash
steps.instruction: After 1 hour, discard the gelatin solution, wash each well with 3 ml PBS, and discard the wash buffer.

steps.title: Seed HUVEC monolayer
steps.instruction: Seed 1 × 10⁴ HUVECs per cm² (including a well for negative gating) in ECGM supplemented with growth factors, 10 % FBS and antibiotics; incubate at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ until confluent (≈ overnight).

steps.title: Prepare THP‑1 cells
steps.instruction: Culture THP‑1 cells in RPMI‑1640 medium with 10 % FBS and antibiotics; count cells with a hemocytometer; aliquot 5 × 10⁵ cells per assay well plus an additional 1 × 10⁵ cells for positive gating control into a centrifuge tube.

steps.title: Label THP‑1 cells with DiI
steps.instruction: Make a 1 mg/ml DiI stock in DMSO; add DiI to THP‑1 cells in complete RPMI (10 % FBS) at a 1:1000 dilution (final 1 µg/ml); incubate 30 minutes at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Wash off unbound DiI
steps.instruction: Centrifuge labeled cells at 300 g for 5 minutes at room temperature; discard supernatant, resuspend pellet in complete media; repeat the centrifugation and wash once more to remove any unbound DiI.

steps.title: Add THP‑1 cells to HUVECs
steps.instruction: Add 5 × 10⁵ DiI‑labeled THP‑1 cells to each HUVEC‑seeded well; incubate 30 minutes at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂; keep the 1 × 10⁵ control THP‑1 cells aside for later flow‑cytometry gating.

steps.title: Wash away non‑adherent THP‑1
steps.instruction: Wash each well three times with PBS to remove unbound monocytes.

steps.title: Detach HUVEC‑THP‑1 complexes
steps.instruction: Add 500 µl TrypLE Express to each well; incubate at 37 °C until cells detach; add 500 µl complete ECGM to inactivate TrypLE.

steps.title: Collect and wash cell suspension
steps.instruction: Transfer the suspension to microcentrifuge tubes; centrifuge at 300 g for 5 minutes at room temperature; discard supernatant, resuspend pellet in PBS; repeat PBS wash once; finally resuspend cells in 500 µl PBS.

steps.title: Acquire flow cytometry data
steps.instruction: Run pure HUVEC and pure THP‑1 populations to set a common vertical gate on FSC vs SSC; acquire 1 × 10⁴ events for each sample; determine percentages of DiI‑negative (HUVEC) and DiI‑positive (THP‑1) cells.

steps.title: Calculate adhesion metric
steps.instruction: Compute the average number of HUVECs adhered per HUVEC by dividing the number of DiI‑positive cells (THP‑1) by the number of DiI‑negative cells (HUVEC) within the 10⁴ events.
